description: This file implements Bluetooth GATT socket functionality, including deserialization of attribute data and handling of Bluetooth protocol commands and responses in the context of a GATT profile.

classes.name: Attribute
classes.description: Represents a Bluetooth GATT attribute with a method to deserialize its data.

classes.name: GATTSocket::Command
classes.description: Handles deserialization and processing of GATT socket commands and responses.

methods.name: Attribute::Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes attribute data from a byte stream according to Bluetooth GATT specifications.

methods.name: GATTSocket::Command::Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes incoming GATT protocol commands and responses from a byte stream.

methods.name: GATTSocket::Security
methods.description: Configures Bluetooth security levels on the socket.

methods.name: GATTSocket::StateChange
methods.description: Overrides state change handler to perform actions when socket state changes.
